dim.description: Dimension to be unflattened, specified as an index into ``input.shape``.
constraints: The product of sizes must equal input.shape[dim] when sizes doesn't contain -1

sizes.description: New shape of the unflattened dimension. One of its elements can be `-1` in which case the corresponding output dimension is inferred. Otherwise, the product of ``sizes`` *must* equal ``input.shape[dim]``.
constraints: The product of sizes must equal input.shape[dim] when sizes doesn't contain -1

output.description: A View of input with the specified dimension unflattened.

constraints: The product of sizes must equal input.shape[dim] when sizes doesn't contain -1
